method: Receipt arithmetic and quality reclassification from saved evaluator measurements; no scientific rerun in this script.
quality_limits: Saved RMSE rounded to 6 decimals and 2D metrics to 4; submitted predictor functions/coefficients absent. Offline replay is separate.

statistical_scope.unit: 4 source-cluster replicates of the same predefined 14 task types, not 56 independent learned mechanisms.
statistical_scope.sign_test_qualification: Illustration under independent exchangeable sign assumptions; does not establish these assumptions or provide a generalization theorem.
